notes.title: You're in for a Ride - Pre-Order Little Nightmares III Now!
notes.content: [h2][b]An ill-fated attempt to bring fun to the funfair. Do what you must to survive the ride, little ones.[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Little Nightmares Showcase[/b] comes with [b]wealth of news on the franchise[/b], as well as a [b]deep dive of the Carnevale chapter[/b], while [b][i]celebrating 20 million units franchise sales[/i][/b].[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="oa85Ns7uegc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]Trapped in the Spiral[/b], a world filled with delusions, [b]Low & Alone are looking for a way out[/b]. [/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="narIoF9doAM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Through their journey, [b]they enter the Carnevale[/b], a [i]decrepit funfair[/i] which is the focus of the [b]new trailer and gameplay deep dive[/b].[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="CD2baUKpm5k;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]In addition, [b]Little Nightmares Enhanced Edition has been announced with a release date also set on 10 October 2025[/b]. Little Nightmares Enhanced Edition brings Six’s story to a new standard thanks to [b]technical enhancements[/b], such as [b]volumetric lightning and ray tracing[/b], as well as [b]gameplay changes[/b] like [b]better checkpoint placement[/b], [b]gameplay helpers[/b], letting more players discover [b][i]Six’s journey through the Maw[/i][/b]. [/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Little Nightmares Enhanced Edition[/b] will [b]be available right away to those who pre-order a digital copy of Little Nightmares III[/b].[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="c6bX6GUEqFQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]The final game announcement from the [b]Little Nightmares Showcase[/b] is [b]Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes[/b], which has been announced to be [b]in development at Iconik Studio[/b].[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="9CvZB0nFaoE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]Little ones, pre-order Little Nightmares III now![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1392860/Little_Nightmares_III/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

Little Nightmares Enhanced Edition brings Six’s story to a new standard thanks to technical enhancements, such as volumetric lightning and ray tracing, as well as gameplay changes like better checkpoint placement, gameplay helpers, letting more players discover Six’s journey through the Maw.

notes.title: A new mystery series In the world of Little Nightmares announced
notes.content:
[h1]Prepare yourselves, little ones. The only way through is down. [/h1]

[h2]The [b]Little Nightmares universe[/b] is being adapted into a [b]new comic book series[/b] called [b][url=https://bnent.eu/LNComics-Announcement]"Descent to Nowhere"[/url][/b]:[/h2]

[url=https://bnent.eu/LNComics-Announcement][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44536241/13b954b0925240f619771ebefc12150ba1245e53.png[/img][/url]
[h3]This limited, [b]four-issue series[/b], produced [b]in partnership with Titan Comics[/b], [b]will begin in 2025[/b], exploring the [i]link between the distorted terrors of the Nowhere, and the sullen humdrum of the Counties[/i]. [/h3]

[h2]Look for [b]more announcements of the new Little Nightmares comic series[/b] very shortly![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1392860/Little_Nightmares_III/

notes.title: Little Nightmares available today on mobile, on iOS, and Android 📱
notes.content:
[h1]The charming horror adventure tale Little Nightmares is now available on mobile, for players to enjoy everywhere![/h1]

[h3]In [b]Little Nightmares[/b], you will have to help Six escape The Maw – a vast, mysterious vessel inhabited by corrupted souls who don’t approve of wayward children. As you progress through your journey, untangle each room's tricky puzzles, hide in the shadows of the monsters' lairs and use your imagination to stay out of harm's way!

[b]Bandai Namco Europe[/b] has worked with [b]Playdigious[/b], a developer known for its mobile adaptations of successful games from console and PC, to bring the atmospheric puzzle platformer to iOS and Android. 

This port is tailored for mobile devices to offer the most comfortable and immersive experience for mobile players.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=gUEILRgdx_A;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]The game has been carefully adapted for mobile with a revamped interface, Game Center achievements, mobile cloud save and 3 Control modes.

Discover the different ways you'll be able to explore the Maw on mobile, on iOS and Android phones.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=C97nkoqdHb8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][list]
[*] [b]Controller Mode[/b] offers users the possibility of playing with MFi controllers (controllers made for Apple devices) while two new Control modes let you to play with the touchscreen.
[*] [b]Standard Mode[/b] lets you play with the various controls appearing on the screen...
[*]...while [b]Immersive Mode[/b] offers greater immersion in the game's atmosphere. 
[/list]
[/h3]

[h1]Special Mobile Launch Giveaway[/h1]

[h3]In celebration of the release, [b]we’re giving away 30 copies of the mobile version[/b] – 15 for iOS and 15 for Android – to 30 lucky children who register for the contest here on our site.

[url=https://bnent.eu/LN1_MobileGiveaway][b]Join in by December 19, 2023[/b][/url] for your chance to win a copy for yourself or download the game on the app store of your choice on December 12, 2023![/h3]

notes.title: Listen to The Sounds of Nightmares 🎙️
notes.content:
[h1][i]Sweets for our sweets...[/i][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26237700/b8af1c378173e80e344b4849a6ca83e5e7f7944a.png[/img]

[h2]Listen to young Noone recount her ever-worsening nightmares to The Counsellor, Otto, in our new podcast series - The Sounds of Nightmares.[/h2]

[h3]Noone, a timid young girl, is committed to The Counties Psychiatric Institute due to her ever-worsening nightmare disorder. She is placed under the care of The Counsellor who has dedicated his life to helping kids overcome their ailments, himself a product of childhood trauma. As their sessions unfold, The Counsellor's past and Noone's nightmares are destined to collide.

New episodes every Tuesday from August 22 through September 19. Subscribe now on your favorite podcast platform.[/h3]

[h1][url=http://thesoundsofnightmares.com]Episodes 1 and 2 are available now[/url][/h1]

[url=http://thesoundsofnightmares.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26237700/68e2c0fcf27d331006fc30805922eb521dd1f7c6.png[/img][/url]

[h2][i]Available in other languages:
[list]
[*] FR - Le Bruit des Cauchemars
[*] ES - El Murmullo de las Pesadillas
[*] DE - Der Klang der Albträume
[*] IT - Il Suono Degli Incubi
[/list][/i][/h2]

notes.title: Are you ready to return to the Nowhere, little ones?
notes.content:
[h1]This time, face your childhood fears [i]together[/i].[/h1]

[h2]Follow the journey of Low & Alone, as they search for a path that could lead them out of the Nowhere.

The two friends will have to work together to survive in a dangerous world full of delusions and escape the grasp of an even greater threat lurking in the shadows.

For the first time in the franchise, face your childhood fears together with a friend in online co-op, or in solo with an AI companion.[/h2]

[previewyoutube=XFHOsobwFrA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Release date and Collector's Edition announced!
notes.content:
Little Nightmares will release on April 28th!
In addition to this great news, we are glad to confirm the game will be available on Playstation 4, Xbox One and PC with digital editions but also with a limited physical ‘Six Edition’ (Check Availability details below).
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26237700/c96efaf9b0e8ba2df70c4183bda49d44d2ebfd50.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26237700/d5a67bafdc66a14885ca8b761d5357e9c07029bf.jpg[/img]

Preorders on Steam:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26237700/d3202982094c1bd71f737a9bc4b6d6174672efb1.jpg[/img]

You want more? Watch the new trailer:
English UK: 
https://youtu.be/IjTuW0uQhag
English US:
https://youtu.be/_JkdZOQomZc
English Australia: 
https://youtu.be/eYZxPfCkYJ4

Don't forget to pay a visit to escapekitchen.little-nightmares.com to try the interactive experience and register to get the exclusive (and free) DLC 'Tengu Mask' 

AVAILABILITY of 'Little Nightmares - Six Edition':
- Europe: PlayStation 4, Xbox One, PC
- North America: PlayStation 4, Xbox One
